name: Hannah Arendt
shortBio: Political theorist who analyzed totalitarianism, civic action in the public realm, and the terrifying 'banality of evil'.
centralQuestion: What preserves the space of public freedom and prevents thoughtless totalitarian evil?

keyWorks.title: The Origins of Totalitarianism
keyWorks.description: Landmark historical-political analysis of imperialism, antisemitism, and the novel institutional mechanics of totalitarian terror.

keyWorks.title: The Human Condition
keyWorks.description: Foundational treatise distinguishing labor, work, and political action (vita activa) as the locus of human plurality and natality.

keyWorks.title: Eichmann in Jerusalem
keyWorks.description: Philosophical reportage introducing the 'banality of evil'—demonstrating how thoughtless bureaucratic conformity enables catastrophic atrocity.
